_comment: Cross-language golden vectors for the wiki-memory L3 URL slug (R-T7, audit R3). The TS minter wikiUrl.ts:slug() is canonical (R-T2 made it THE live substrate minter); scripts/lib/rdf_gen.py:slug() is RECONCILED to match it. Both a vitest test (shared/markdown-parsing) and a pytest (tests/test_slug_golden_vectors.py) run their slug over these vectors and assert `expected`. The `applyCitekeyStrip` cases run slug(stripCitekeyMarker(input)) — the URL-minting path (targetUrlFor / _resolve), not bare slug. Divergences these vectors lock (TS side won each): heading-anchor strip, folder-prefix strip, ASCII-only \w, double-hyphen preservation.

vectors.note: folder prefix wins over ampersand handling (last segment only)
ASCII-only \w: diacritics dropped (JS \w semantics, Python re.ASCII)
folder prefix: keep only the last path segment
whitespace run collapses to one hyphen

citekeyVectors.note: citekey @-marker stripped (slug strips @ anyway; URL path uses stripCitekeyMarker)
